description:
SAP Application Developer 
 

 On behalf of our client, Procom Services is searching for a SAP Application Developer for a contract opportunity located in Hillsboro, OR.
 

 SAP Application Developer Job Details 
 

 The developer(s) will work closely with technical team to deliver customizations/enhancements to SAP capabilities in support of customer requirements. Responsiblities include requirements analysis, technical documentation and testing of solutions.
 
 
 SAP Application Developer Mandatory Skills 
 

 Must be skilled in SAP ABAP (Advanced Business Application Programming) 
 Highly Desired and looking for additional experience in: ABAP/BW (ABAP/Business information Warehouse and ABAP/ALE (ABAP/Application Link Enabling) 
 Candidates need to have 7+ years experience 
 Education - preference to have a BS degree and/or equivalant experience
 SAP Application Developer Start Date 
 

 ASAP
 

 SAP Application Developer Assignment Length 
 

 2 months
 

 "Please note that we are not able to work with candidates on H1B Visas or candidates represented by third parties." 


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Please send your resume in Word format only.
